state.goal: Decide how to handle CSV processing in a small internal tool
state.question: Should the tool process CSV with the standard library or add a dependency?
known_constraints: the tool must install without reaching a package registry
evidence: the files use plain RFC 4180 CSV
the standard library csv module covers the required reading and writing
the tool is one script with no other dependencies

alternatives.name: Standard library only
alternatives.description: Use the built-in csv module for all reading and writing.

alternatives.name: Add tablib
alternatives.description: Introduce tablib as a lightweight tabular data library.
disadvantages: extra dependency for needs the stdlib covers
